text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well done!
You showed me a radiance shining like the sun!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering such a high-level race
is proof of how much you've both grown."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: For now, let us simply praise that raw talent.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"I believe both you and your trainee
gained tremendous experience from this race."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
So let's do our best again...
Aiming to run in the 'SWBC' next time, against even tougher rivals~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A race where only those with true potential were selected by an AI that knows everything there is to know about Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My heart fluttered with excitement, thinking that if <chrname> produced results there, she might become a legendary figure etched into history.
choice_data_list: (I'll make sure to get an invitation again next time!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon the intrusion, Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glace... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry I haven't been getting results lately.
I didn't run a satisfying race in today's WBC, either.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...It is not your fault.
You are doing everything you possibly can."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
No, there must be more I can do.
Both in physical training and classroom studies, all sorts of things...!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I'll try much, much harder!
I'll do my best, and next time, I will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I only came here to say that.
And to fire myself up, too...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Let us do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(...I am the one who needs to put in the effort.
I must deliver results no matter what...)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a whole year
has just flown by, hasn't it, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
“I think that's only because running alongside
Bitter Glasse has been so fulfilling.”

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...It went by in a flash for me too.
...I wish it could have lasted longer..."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
My goal... didn't make it in time...
...Time is so mean... It never waits for you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...No, even so, Meek did her best.
It was precisely because she set a goal and aimed for it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
What's important is running toward our goal!
And our hard work is finally about to blossom!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Lately, her physique has visibly changed, and both her endurance and times are improving.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: The peak is definitely coming—so let's keep working hard together like this! Next year, let's show everyone the results of all our efforts!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...
..........Understood.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Good night then.
Have a Happy New Year, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
......Have a Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...We've worked hard, step by step, to get here.
Let's make our efforts blossom, Bitter Glasse...!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Me too...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, we did it.
Trainer Kashimoto...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That was a powerful run until the very end, Little Cocon.
...You really showed them.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
First me earlier, and now Little Cocon!
Both of us winning on the same day is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Both of them are incredible.
I am truly—deeply proud of them.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win soon, too...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
“...Soon...
...I want to make Trainer happy...!”
